died.name: John of the Cross
died.cause: dying at the stroke of midnight

died.name: George Washington
died.cause: to Dr. James Craik and his personal secretary, Tobias Lear
died.last_words: I die hard, but I am not afraid to go... I am just going. Have me decently buried, and do not let my body be put into the vault in less than two days after I am dead. Do you understand me? 'Tis well.

died.name: George Dashiell Bayard
died.desc: Union general of the American Civil War
died.cause: mortally wounded at the Battle of Fredericksburg
died.last_words: Tell McClellan that my last regret as a military man is that I did not die serving under him.

died.name: Princess Alice of the United Kingdom
Sidónio Pais

died.last_words: I die well! Save the Fatherland!

died.name: George Gipp
died.cause: to Knute Rockne while dying of pneumonia
died.last_words: Some day, when things look real tough for Notre Dame [Notre Dame Fighting Irish football], ask the boys to go out there and win one for the Gipper.

died.name: Lupe Vélez
died.cause: in her suicide note, addressed to actor Harald Ramond. Vélez was pregnant with Ramond's child at the time
died.last_words: To Harald, may God forgive you and forgive me too but I prefer to take my life away and our baby's before I bring him with shame or killing him, Lupe.

died.name: Maurice Baring
died.cause: when asked what he wanted for lunch
died.last_words: Whatever you would like me to have.

died.name: Stanley Spencer

born.name: Nostradamus
born.last_words: Tomorrow, at sunrise, I shall no longer be here.

born.name: Tycho Brahe
born.cause: to his assistant Johannes Kepler The Danish astronomer contracted a bladder or kidney ailment after attending a banquet in Prague and died eleven days later. According to Johannes Kepler's first-hand account, Brahe had refused to leave the banquet to relieve himself, because it would have been a breach of etiquette. After he had returned home, he was no longer able to urinate, except eventually in very small quantities and with excruciating pain. Though initially ascribed to a kidney stone, and later still to potential mercury poisoning, modern analyses indicate Brahe's death resulted from a fatal case of uremia caused by an inflamed prostate.
born.last_words: May I not seem to have lived in vain.

born.name: Frances Ridley Havergal
born.cause: possibly trying to say, "He died for me."

born.name: Jack Cole
born.desc: American cartoonist, creator of Plastic Man
born.cause: in his suicide note to Hugh Hefner
born.last_words: Dear Hef, When you read this I shall be dead. I cannot go on living with myself and hurting those dear to me. What I do has nothing to do with you.
